title: Normalized finite evaluation data for the coefficient pairing
statement: In the setup and finite model of [def-coef-finite-projection-evaluation-data], let $m$ and $s$ be the normalized system model and scalar specialization of [lem-coef-system-projection-evaluation], at positive coefficient exponent $n+1$. A finite pairing evaluation datum consists of a finite model, exact tensor evaluation comparisons for $X,Y,Z$ and integral/quotient point towers, and finite sections comparisons for $X,Y$. Ordinary tensor comparisons send actual local pure tensors to the same pure tensors; their derived comparisons satisfy the universal total-complex normalization. It includes left-adjoint evaluation isomorphisms for the two sections functors and scalar extension, with the explicit evaluated unit and counit equations, and the same unit/counit equations for the canonical native proper pull/push evaluation comparisons. Strong tensor comparisons commute with these evaluations. Signed symmetry commutes with quotient point and source-site evaluation. Sections pullback composition and the compactification pullback compositor commute with the canonical evaluations. The evaluated system open tensor map equals the canonical finite sheafified open chain map [lem-coef-support-open-tensor-model], under the exact open, pullback and tensor comparisons. Finally, for every completed-coefficient $K$ and arbitrary quotient-system $N$, the evaluated internal Hom of $M=L\rho_X^*\operatorname{const}K$ is isomorphic to the finite internal Hom of $M_n,N_n$; the isomorphism is precisely the tensor-Hom transpose of evaluated closed evaluation, not a freely chosen map [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model, lem-coef-hom-tower-scalar-model]. No existence assertion or preservation of K-injective evaluations is part of this definition.
